_comment: Mapped against the real Ricochet export (Products 2026-09-03T…Z.csv, 1606 rows). Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation. First alias with a NON-EMPTY value wins, so dead columns in the export (Brand, Supplier, Department) fall through harmlessly.

skuCleanup._comment: Ricochet writes SKUs as '004001 — a leading apostrophe is Excel's text guard, not part of the SKU. Stripped before the SKU is used as a key or a filename.

assets._comment: The export carries NO image column and never will — photos are joined here by SKU. requireImageToPublish is false for launch so the catalog can go live on placeholders; flip it true once real photography exists and unphotographed items should be held back instead.

catalog._comment: The export has no Shopify/online toggle, so requirePublishedColumn is false and availability is decided by the Inventory status column instead of by quantity alone.
catalog._facetComment: Browse axes. `maker` and `price` and `new` come straight out of the export and are authoritative; `category` is the derived keyword guess and is the only one that can be wrong.
